sloka: न्यस्ताम् सागर तोये वा पाताले वा अपि मैथिलीम् ।आनयेयम् तव आदेशात् श्वेताम् अश्वतरीम् इव ॥४-१७-५१॥
transliteration: nyastām sāgara toye vā pātāle vā api maithilīm ।ānayeyam tava ādeśāt śvetām aśvatarīm iva ॥4-17-51॥

translations.english: 'Sugriva inheriting the kingdom after my departure to heaven is proper. But your killing me this way in the combat by unjustifiable means is not.
